entities.summary: The Progress Singapore Party is a liberal political party in Singapore. It was one of the three political parties represented in the 14th Parliament, alongside the governing People's Action Party (PAP) and the fellow opposition Workers' Party (WP); Leong Mun Wai and Hazel Poa represented it as non-constituency Members of Parliament (NCMPs). Progress Singapore Party is a political party in Asia, established in 2019-03-28. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
